evidence.note: Proposes DisCO, a discriminative constrained-optimization alternative to GRPO for RL-training of large reasoning models, that removes question-level difficulty bias and entropy instability, giving average gains of 7% over GRPO and 6% over DAPO on math reasoning benchmarks with a 1.5B model.
evidence.title: DisCO: Reinforcing Large Reasoning Models with Discriminative Constrained Optimization
